quarterly_data.quarter: Yoke Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Precursors in 2025 (company): its precursors (high-k, silicon-based and metal) are used in advanced processes for 3D NAND and NOR flash, DRAM and logic chips, sold to leading domestic and overseas chipmakers; with R&D teams in China and Korea it is developing precursors for advanced-node thin-film deposition and for complex AI advanced-packaging chipsets. Products of Jiangsu Xianke's precursor localization project successively passed domestic customer qualification and the lines moved into volume trial production with output gradually expanding; 2025 precursor sales kept growing with higher profit. The company is planning domestic sourcing of precursor metal raw materials. Its Korean semiconductor-chemicals holding company (Korea Xianke) had 2025 revenue of RMB 172,283.48 ten-thousand (-2.48%) and net profit of RMB 27,368.45 ten-thousand (-41.33%), which the company attributes to lower semiconductor chemical sales.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yoke Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Precursor R&D projects in 2025: high-purity metal precursors for advanced nodes (expected to cover Cu, Co and Ru precursors and complete the ALD precursor line) concluded in December 2025; a new-generation high-k lanthanum precursor project and a spin-on dielectric (SOD) project also concluded in December 2025; solid-precursor pretreatment and a dedicated vaporisation-evaluation rig (2 sets) are in development; an area-selective deposition (ASD) evaluation system was completed. Packaging photoresists: RDL photoresist for wafer-level packaging and a high-resolution RDL chemically amplified resist for IDMs are in customer R&D qualification.

quarterly_data.quarter: Yoke Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Packaging fillers (company): the raw-material line of Huzhou Yoke Huafei Electronic Materials' 3.9 ten-thousand-tonne-a-year semiconductor core materials project was completed, and 9 lines of Yoke Xianke (Chengdu)'s 2.4 ten-thousand-tonne-a-year electronic materials project moved into volume production, supplying semi-finished spherical silica to Huafei; high-purity low-alpha spherical alumina for memory, AI-chip and 3D-packaging fillers is developed and ramping in volume; low-dielectric spherical silica for high-end substrates was developed; EMC spherical silica completed sample evaluation.
